Finding the perfect apartment in Dhaka can be overwhelming with the city’s rapid expansion and numerous residential options. Not every neighborhood provides the same level of convenience, security, and modern facilities. Choosing the right location requires careful assessment of essential factors such as infrastructure, accessibility, and lifestyle amenities.
To assist you in making an informed decision, we have compiled a list of the ten best areas for purchasing an apartment in Dhaka. Explore the highlights of each locality below.
Top 10 Areas for Apartment Investments in Dhaka
1. Bashundhara Residential Area

Bashundhara R/A is one of Dhaka’s most well-planned and upscale residential communities. Situated close to Baridhara and just minutes away from Gulshan 1 and 2, this area offers premium living standards.
Why choose Bashundhara R/A?
• A range of apartment options with modern architecture.
• Top-tier schools, hospitals, and shopping malls.
• High-security measures, including CCTV and 24/7 security personnel.
• Well-maintained roads, reliable utilities, and proper drainage systems.
2. Mirpur
Mirpur is one of the largest and most diverse areas in Dhaka, offering a mix of affordability and elite residential zones. Its well-connected road networks link it to major parts of the city.
Why invest in Mirpur?
• Affordable housing alongside high-end apartments.
• Close proximity to Gulshan, Banani, and Uttara.
• Excellent amenities including supermarkets, hospitals, and recreational hubs.
• Home to renowned schools and universities.
3. Uttara

Uttara is a meticulously planned residential zone, offering a balance between urban convenience and tranquility. With easy access to Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport and major highways, it is a strategic location for homeowners.
What makes Uttara ideal?
• A secure and well-maintained neighborhood with gated communities
• Parks, lakes, and open spaces for a better quality of life.
• Rapid real estate growth ensures high investment returns.
• A hub of commercial and corporate activity.
4. Mohammadpur

Mohammadpur is an emerging real estate hotspot known for its affordability and vibrant community. It’s an excellent option for homebuyers seeking budget-friendly properties without compromising on amenities.
Why consider Mohammadpur?
• Competitive apartment pricing within reach of many buyers.
• A thriving social scene with restaurants, cafés, and entertainment options.
• Well-connected to Mirpur and Dhanmondi, easing daily commutes.
• Growing demand for real estate, making it a smart investment.
5. Dhanmondi
Dhanmondi is a prestigious location offering a blend of residential and commercial developments. With its prime positioning, the area ensures high-quality living standards.
Reasons to buy in Dhanmondi:
• Access to top-tier schools, hospitals, and shopping centers.
• A mix of luxury and standard apartment options.
• Proximity to Dhanmondi Lake, a perfect place for leisure and relaxation.
• Growing commercial developments increase property value over time.
6. Gulshan
Gulshan is one of Dhaka’s most sought-after and upscale residential areas. It serves as the diplomatic and business hub of the city.
Why invest in Gulshan?
• Home to embassies, luxury hotels, and high-end restaurants.
• Exclusive gated communities ensuring privacy and security.
• Premier shopping destinations, private clubs, and social networking spots.
• High appreciation value for real estate investments.
7. Baridhara
Baridhara is known for its elite residential environment and high-security measures. It is home to many diplomatic missions and international organizations.
Key advantages of Baridhara:
• Luxurious apartments with spacious layouts and modern amenities.
• Round-the-clock security with police surveillance.
• Reliable utilities and well-maintained infrastructure.
• A peaceful environment with green spaces and wide roads.
8. Nikunja
Nikunja is a rapidly developing residential zone that offers excellent connectivity and modern living amenities.
Why consider Nikunja?
• Close proximity to the airport and major commercial hubs.
• A range of apartment choices with modern facilities.
• Well-planned roads and drainage systems.
• A growing number of shopping centers, schools, and healthcare facilities.
9. Banani
Banani is a high-end residential and commercial area in Dhaka, offering a mix of luxury apartments and modern conveniences.
Why invest in Banani?
• Close to Gulshan and diplomatic zones.
• Upscale restaurants, shopping malls, and entertainment spots.
• Premium apartment options with high-end security.
• Thriving business community with corporate offices and co-working spaces.
10. Purbachal
Purbachal is the largest planned township in Bangladesh, set to be a future hub for urban living with massive infrastructure projects underway.
Why buy property in Purbachal?
• Government-backed urban development ensures long-term growth.
• Wide roads, modern utilities, and planned green spaces.
• A peaceful alternative to Dhaka’s crowded neighborhoods.
• Potential for high appreciation in property value.
Final Thoughts

Selecting the right location for purchasing an apartment in Dhaka depends on lifestyle preferences, budget, and investment potential. Whether you seek affordability, luxury, or a mix of both, the ten areas listed above provide excellent choices with well-developed infrastructure and modern conveniences.

Before finalizing your investment, assess the long-term value, security, and accessibility of your preferred neighborhood. By doing so, you can ensure a smart and rewarding real estate decision in one of Dhaka’s thriving residential zones.

It is no secret that real estate in Dhaka is highly sought-after. The city has a dynamic and ever-changing market which makes it an attractive option for investors and buyers alike. But one area that stands out as a top choice for many is known as the Diplomatic Zone, located near the heart of the city. Let’s explore why this area in particular has become so popular and what you can expect from living in the Diplomatic Zone.
What is the Diplomatic Zone?

The Diplomatic Zone is an exclusive real estate area located in Gulshan, Dhaka. It is home to some of the most luxurious properties in the city, with stunning views and high end amenities. This zone was established by Sharif Properties Service as an exclusive enclave for foreign diplomats, international companies, and wealthy individuals who want to live or work in Dhaka but require a higher level of security or privacy than available elsewhere. It consists of residential buildings, office spaces, shopping malls and other facilities catering exclusively to its residents.
Why Choose this Area?

This area offers many advantages over other parts of Dhaka when it comes to buying property. Firstly, it is much more secure than other areas due to its exclusive nature and heightened security measures put in place by Sharif Properties Services. Secondly, it provides easy access to all parts of Dhaka via well-developed transportation links such as roads and highways. Thirdly, it boasts spacious residential buildings with large balconies that provide amazing views of the city skyline - perfect for those looking for a luxurious lifestyle! Lastly, there are numerous shops and restaurants nearby catering specifically to residents of this zone - making it a convenient choice for business people or those looking to invest in property here.
What Amenities Does This Area Offer?

The Diplomatic Zone offers all sorts of amenities designed to make life easier for its residents. There are 24-hour security services available at all times, as well as private pools, gyms, spas, parks and playgrounds within walking distance from most buildings. Residents also have access to high speed internet connections throughout their stay in this zone - making communication with friends overseas or conducting business much easier! In addition to these amenities there are also several restaurants offering international cuisine within walking distance from most buildings - ensuring that anyone living here won’t go hungry!
Conclusion:

In summary, if you're considering investing in real estate in Dhaka then you should definitely look into investing in the Diplomatic Zone offered by Sharif Properties Service. With its exclusive nature offering heightened security measures coupled with easy access to all parts of Dhaka via well developed transportation links; not to mention spacious residential buildings boasting large balconies providing stunning views.

This zone has everything you need for a luxurious lifestyle! Add on top of that numerous amenities such as private pools and gyms plus restaurants catering specifically towards residents – then you have yourself a great choice when it comes to investing your money wisely!

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Furnished Apartment Rentals in Banani
1. What are the benefits of renting a furnished apartment in Banani?

Renting a furnished apartment in Banani provides convenience, as you don't have to worry about purchasing or transporting furniture. It’s a great choice for people who are moving to the area temporarily or looking for a hassle-free living solution. Furnished apartments come with essential items like beds, sofas, tables, and kitchen appliances, allowing you to move in immediately.
2. How much does it cost to rent a furnished apartment in Banani?

Rental prices for furnished apartments in Banani can vary depending on factors like size, location, and amenities. On average, a one-bedroom furnished apartment may cost between BDT 30,000 to BDT 70,000 per month. Larger apartments with more luxurious amenities can go for BDT 100,000 or more.
3. What amenities are typically included in a furnished apartment rental in Banani?
Most furnished apartments in Banani offer basic amenities such as:
Fully furnished living rooms (sofas, coffee tables, TV)
Fully equipped kitchen (fridge, microwave, stove, basic utensils)
Comfortable bedrooms (beds, wardrobes, bedside tables)
Air conditioning (in most units)
High-speed internet
24/7 security and sometimes concierge service
Some apartments may also offer additional amenities like a swimming pool, gym, or parking space.
4. Are utilities included in the rental price?

Utilities such as water, electricity, gas, and internet are often charged separately, though some rental listings may include them in the overall rent. Be sure to clarify with the landlord or agent about what is included and what additional costs you may have to cover.
5. How long can I rent a furnished apartment in Banani?

Furnished apartment rentals in Banani typically offer flexible lease terms, ranging from monthly to one-year contracts. Short-term rentals are often available, which makes it ideal for expats, business professionals, or anyone needing temporary housing.
6. Is the area of Banani safe to live in?

Yes, Banani is considered one of the safer and more upscale areas in Dhaka. The neighborhood is well-developed, with many embassies, corporate offices, and high-end restaurants. There is 24/7 security and surveillance in most apartment buildings, making it a safe choice for both local and international residents.
7. Do I need a guarantor to rent an apartment in Banani?

In some cases, landlords may require a guarantor or a reference, especially for expats or individuals who are renting for the first time in Dhaka. However, many landlords are flexible and may accept advance payment or a higher security deposit as an alternative.
8. What is the process for renting a furnished apartment in Banani?
The typical process for renting a furnished apartment in Banani includes:
Searching for available listings (online platforms, real estate agents, or word of mouth)
Visiting the apartment and evaluating its condition
Negotiating the rent and lease terms
Signing the lease agreement and paying a security deposit (usually 1-3 months’ rent)
Moving in and paying monthly rent as per the agreement
Make sure to verify all terms and conditions before signing any agreements.
9. Can I customize the furniture in a furnished apartment in Banani?

Generally, the furniture in a furnished apartment is provided as-is, and customization is not allowed. However, you may be able to request minor adjustments or additions (like extra storage or a different type of bed) depending on the landlord’s flexibility.
10. Are pets allowed in furnished apartments in Banani?

Pet policies vary by building and landlord. Some furnished apartments in Banani may allow pets with a pet deposit or additional fee, while others may have strict no-pet policies. It’s important to clarify this with the landlord before committing to a rental.
11. What is the best way to find a furnished apartment in Banani?
You can find available furnished apartments in Banani by:
Checking online real estate platforms (like Bproperty, Bikroy, or Lamudi)
Contacting local real estate agents who specialize in Banani rentals
Asking for recommendations from friends, colleagues, or expat communities
Walking around the area and looking for "For Rent" signs on buildings
12. Is parking available with furnished apartments in Banani?

Many furnished apartments in Banani offer parking spaces, but availability may depend on the building. Some buildings may have designated parking areas, while others may have limited or no parking options. Always confirm with the landlord or agent if you need a parking spot.
13. Can I negotiate the rent for a furnished apartment in Banani?

While rental prices in Banani are generally fixed, it may be possible to negotiate the rent, especially for longer-term leases. If you are renting during off-peak months (such as during the rainy season or around holidays), landlords may be more flexible with pricing.
14. How do I make payments for rent in Banani?
Most landlords prefer payments via bank transfer or mobile payment services such as Bkash or Nagad. It’s essential to keep a record of all transactions and ask for receipts when making payments.
15. What should I do if I encounter problems in my furnished apartment?

If any issues arise with the apartment (e.g., plumbing, electricity, or furniture damage), you should contact the landlord or property management company immediately. Most furnished apartments come with maintenance support, but it’s important to understand the terms for repairs before moving in.

Introduction to Building Maintenance in Dhaka

In the heart of Dhaka, where the city’s skyline is constantly evolving and infrastructure grows by leaps and bounds, maintaining the integrity of your building is crucial. From commercial buildings to residential complexes, efficient building maintenance ensures that your property remains in peak condition, delivering comfort, safety, and long-term value. With professional building maintenance services in Dhaka, you can rest assured that your property will stand the test of time.
Why Building Maintenance in Dhaka is Essential?
Enhanced Property Longevity

Regular maintenance extends the lifespan of your building, reducing the need for costly repairs. From structural inspections to preventive measures, our maintenance services ensure that your property remains in prime condition for years to come.
Safety and Compliance

In a city as dynamic as Dhaka, adhering to safety codes and regulations is non-negotiable. With expert building maintenance, we ensure that your building complies with local laws, minimizing risks and providing a secure environment for all occupants.
Optimized Energy Efficiency

Keeping your building energy-efficient not only cuts down on costs but also contributes to a greener, more sustainable environment. Our maintenance services include energy-efficient solutions that optimize heating, cooling, lighting, and water usage, helping you save money while reducing your carbon footprint.
Maximized Comfort and Functionality

A well-maintained building promotes the comfort and convenience of residents, tenants, and employees. Our services focus on creating a functional and comfortable environment by managing everything from HVAC systems to elevators and plumbing.
Our Comprehensive Building Maintenance Services in Dhaka

Preventive Maintenance: Regular inspections and timely maintenance to avoid costly repairs down the line. Our team ensures that every aspect of your building is functioning properly, from electrical systems to plumbing.
HVAC Maintenance: We provide thorough inspections and servicing of HVAC systems, ensuring consistent climate control, energy efficiency, and comfort for everyone in your building.
Electrical Systems Maintenance: From routine checks to repairing and upgrading electrical systems, we ensure that your building’s electrical infrastructure remains safe and reliable.

Plumbing & Water Systems: Leaky pipes or faulty water systems can cause significant damage if not addressed quickly. Our plumbing maintenance services guarantee that water systems function seamlessly and efficiently.
Elevator Maintenance: Regular servicing of elevators to ensure smooth operation, reducing the risk of breakdowns and improving safety for building occupants.

Roofing and Structural Inspections: Prevent leaks and structural damages with regular roof inspections and maintenance. We ensure that your building’s exterior and foundation remain secure and weather-resistant.

Cleaning & Janitorial Services: A clean building is a healthy building. We provide comprehensive cleaning services, including common areas, offices, and even specialized cleaning for unique facilities like gymnasiums or parking lots.
Fire Safety Systems: Ensure that your building is equipped with properly functioning fire alarms, extinguishers, and sprinkler systems to protect residents and employees in case of emergencies.
Why Choose Us for Building Maintenance in Dhaka?
Experienced Professionals

Our team comprises highly skilled technicians who are experts in various aspects of building maintenance. With years of experience in Dhaka, we understand the specific challenges that buildings face in this dynamic city.
Customized Maintenance Plans

Every building has its own set of needs. We create tailored maintenance plans that suit the unique demands of your property, whether it’s a high-rise office building, a residential complex, or a mixed-use facility.
Cost-Effective Solutions

We believe that quality maintenance shouldn’t break the bank. Our services are designed to offer high-value solutions that ensure the longevity and performance of your building while staying within your budget.
Prompt and Reliable Service
We understand the importance of timely maintenance. Our team responds quickly to any issues, ensuring minimal disruption to your operations and a quick resolution to any maintenance concerns.
Advanced Tools and Technology
We use the latest tools and technologies to deliver efficient and accurate maintenance services, minimizing downtime and maximizing the efficiency of your building’s systems.
The Benefits of Regular Building Maintenance in Dhaka
Prevents Costly Repairs: Preventive maintenance helps detect minor issues before they become major problems, saving you money on repairs.
Improves Tenant Satisfaction: A well-maintained building creates a comfortable and safe environment, leading to higher satisfaction and tenant retention.
Boosts Property Value: Regular maintenance keeps your building attractive, functional, and safe, which in turn increases its market value and appeal to potential buyers or renters.
Reduces Energy Costs: Maintaining systems like HVAC, lighting, and plumbing ensures they work efficiently, which helps reduce energy consumption and utility costs.
Contact Us for Your Building Maintenance Needs

Our professional maintenance services offer peace of mind, knowing that your building is in expert hands. Let us help you preserve the value, safety, and functionality of your property. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Property Management in Dhaka
1. What is property management?

Answer: Property management refers to the operation, control, and oversight of real estate properties on behalf of the property owner. This includes tasks like maintenance, tenant management, rent collection, and ensuring that properties are in good condition.
2. What services do property management companies in Dhaka offer?
Answer: Property management companies in Dhaka typically provide services such as:
Tenant placement and screening
Rent collection
Property maintenance and repairs
Lease management
Handling legal issues related to property
Marketing and advertising vacant properties
Regular inspections of the property
3. How do property management companies in Dhaka charge?

Answer: Most property management companies in Dhaka charge a percentage of the monthly rent, usually between 8% and 15%. Some companies may also charge additional fees for maintenance, advertising, or leasing services. It’s important to clarify the fee structure before signing an agreement.
4. Can property management companies handle tenant disputes in Dhaka?

Answer: Yes, a property management company in Dhaka can handle tenant disputes, including issues related to late rent payments, property damage, and lease violations. They act as an intermediary to resolve conflicts in accordance with the rental agreement.
5. How do I choose a property management company in Dhaka?
Answer: When choosing a property management company in Dhaka, consider the following factors:
Reputation: Check reviews and ask for references.
Experience: Look for a company with experience in managing properties in Dhaka.
Services: Ensure they offer the services you need, such as maintenance and tenant management.
Cost: Compare fees and understand the pricing structure.
Communication: Ensure they provide clear and timely communication.
6. How can I ensure my property is well-maintained in Dhaka?

Answer: A good property management company in Dhaka will conduct regular inspections, coordinate repairs, and ensure preventive maintenance is done. They should also have a network of trusted contractors to handle issues like plumbing, electrical work, and other necessary repairs.
7. What are the legal responsibilities of property owners in Dhaka?
Answer: As a property owner in Dhaka, you are responsible for:
Ensuring the property is habitable and safe for tenants.
Complying with local zoning and building codes.
Paying property taxes and other necessary fees.
Providing a clear lease agreement outlining tenant responsibilities.
Responding to repair and maintenance requests promptly.
8. Can property management companies in Dhaka help with renting out my property?

Answer: Yes, most property management companies in Dhaka can help market and rent out your property. They will handle advertising, showings, tenant screening, and lease negotiations to ensure a smooth rental process.
9. How does rent collection work in Dhaka property management?

Answer: Property management companies collect rent on behalf of property owners, typically on a monthly basis. They often offer multiple payment methods, such as bank transfers, online payments, or physical payment options. They are responsible for following up on late payments and ensuring rent is paid on time.
10. Is property management in Dhaka necessary for small property owners?

Answer: While some small property owners may choose to manage their properties themselves, property management can save time and hassle. It ensures that your property is maintained properly, tenants are managed professionally, and legal and financial issues are handled efficiently. This is particularly useful if you own multiple properties or if you live outside Dhaka.
11. What types of properties do property management companies in Dhaka manage?
Answer: Property management companies in Dhaka typically manage:
Residential properties (apartments, houses, villas)
Commercial properties (offices, retail spaces)
Mixed-use properties (buildings that contain both residential and commercial spaces)
12. How can I terminate a property management agreement in Dhaka?

Answer: Property management agreements usually have a termination clause that specifies how either party can end the contract. Typically, you must give notice (e.g., 30 or 60 days) and may be required to pay a termination fee depending on the terms of the agreement.

Looking to buy, sell, or rent in Dhaka’s most sought-after residential areas? We specialize in Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara, Bashundhara, Uttara, Dhanmondi, Mohammadpur, and the emerging city of Purbachal. Whether you're searching for a luxury apartment, a commercial space, or a profitable investment, we provide expert guidance tailored to your needs.
Prime Residential & Investment Areas in Dhaka
1. Gulshan – The Heart of Luxury Living

Gulshan is Dhaka’s most prestigious area, home to embassies, multinational corporations, and luxury residences. Known for its high-end apartments, duplexes, and exclusive villas, it’s perfect for those seeking an elite lifestyle.
Property Types: Luxury apartments, penthouses, villas, commercial spaces
Ideal for: Diplomats, corporate executives, high-net-worth individuals
Key Attractions: Gulshan Avenue, Hatirjheel Lake, top restaurants, five-star hotels
2. Banani – Vibrant & Modern City Life

Banani is an upscale, trendy area with a mix of residential and commercial properties. Its lively atmosphere, premium restaurants, and corporate offices make it a preferred location for professionals and business owners.
Property Types: High-end apartments, serviced residences, office spaces
Ideal for: Young professionals, entrepreneurs, expats
Key Attractions: Banani 11, top cafés, boutique shopping
3. Baridhara – Exclusive Diplomatic Zone

Baridhara is an elite residential area, known for housing foreign embassies and high-profile residents. It offers a peaceful environment with strict security, making it a top choice for diplomats and business leaders.
Property Types: Luxury villas, upscale apartments, embassy buildings
Ideal for: Diplomats, expats, high-profile executives
Key Attractions: Baridhara Park, international schools, secure environment
4. Bashundhara – A Family-Friendly Haven
Bashundhara is a rapidly growing residential hub with modern infrastructure, wide roads, and a peaceful ambiance. It’s perfect for families looking for spacious homes in a serene environment.
Property Types: Large apartments, townhouses, commercial plots
Ideal for: Families, professionals, investors
Key Attractions: Jamuna Future Park, North South University, Apollo Hospital
5. Uttara – Planned & Self-Sufficient Community

Uttara offers a well-planned urban lifestyle with wide roads, green parks, and excellent amenities. It is divided into sectors, each with its own facilities, making it a convenient choice for residents.
Property Types: Mid-to-high-end apartments, commercial buildings, gated communities
Ideal for: Families, corporate professionals, business owners
Key Attractions: Uttara Sector 4 & 7 markets, international schools, parks
6. Dhanmondi – A Blend of Heritage & Modern Living

Dhanmondi is one of Dhaka’s oldest residential areas, known for its elite schools, cultural hubs, and upscale properties. It’s ideal for those who want a central location with a blend of history and modernity.
Property Types: Luxury apartments, independent houses, commercial spaces

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Furnished & Serviced Apartments for Rent in Banani
1. What is a furnished & serviced apartment?
A furnished & serviced apartment is a fully furnished rental unit that includes furniture, appliances, kitchenware, and utilities, along with services like housekeeping, security, and maintenance.
2. What amenities are included in a serviced apartment?
Typically, serviced apartments in Banani include:
Fully furnished living space
Equipped kitchen (stove, fridge, microwave, utensils, etc.)
Housekeeping services
Wi-Fi and cable TV
24/7 security and CCTV surveillance
Utility services (electricity, water, gas)
Laundry services or washing machine
Gym and swimming pool (available in some apartments)
3. What is the minimum rental period?
The minimum rental period varies, but most serviced apartments in Banani require a stay of at least one month. However, some providers offer weekly stays.
4. What is the rental cost of a furnished & serviced apartment in Banani? Rental prices depend on the size, location, and amenities. On average:
1-bedroom apartments: BDT 60,000 - 100,000 per month
2-bedroom apartments: BDT 100,000 - 180,000 per month
3-bedroom apartments: BDT 150,000 - 300,000 per month
5. Are utilities included in the rent?
Some serviced apartments include utilities in the rent, while others may charge separately for electricity, water, and internet. Always confirm before renting.
6. Can I rent on a short-term basis?
Yes, many serviced apartments in Banani offer short-term rentals, including weekly or monthly stays, making them ideal for business travelers and expats.
7. Is there a security deposit?
Yes, most landlords require a security deposit, typically equivalent to one or two months' rent, which is refundable upon contract completion.
8. Are pets allowed in serviced apartments?
Pet policies vary by apartment. Some allow pets with additional deposits, while others have a strict no-pet policy. Confirm with the provider before booking.
9. How do I book a furnished & serviced apartment in Banani?
You can book through real estate agents, property rental websites, or directly from serviced apartment providers. Advance booking is recommended, especially during peak seasons.
10. Can I extend my stay?
Yes, most serviced apartments allow extensions based on availability. Notify the provider as early as possible to secure your stay.
11. What are the advantages of renting a serviced apartment over a hotel?
More space and privacy
Fully equipped kitchen for self-cooking
Cost-effective for long-term stays
Home-like comfort with hotel-like services
Ideal for families, business travelers, and expats
12. Is there 24/7 customer support?
Most serviced apartments have a reception or management team available for assistance, ensuring a hassle-free stay.
For more details or to book a furnished & serviced apartment in Banani, contact a trusted real estate agent or service provider today!

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Furnished Apartments for Rent in Baridhara
1. What is the average rent for furnished apartments in Baridhara?

The rent for furnished apartments in Baridhara varies depending on the size, location, and amenities of the apartment. On average, you can expect to pay between BDT 40,000 and BDT 150,000 per month for a fully furnished apartment. Please contact us for more specific pricing based on your requirements.
2. What is included in a furnished apartment?

A furnished apartment typically includes essential furniture such as beds, sofas, tables, chairs, wardrobes, and appliances like refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners. Some apartments may also include additional amenities such as Wi-Fi, TV, and kitchenware.
3. Is a security deposit required for renting a furnished apartment in Baridhara?
Yes, most landlords require a security deposit, which is typically one or two months' rent. This deposit is refundable at the end of the lease, provided there is no damage to the property.
4. Can I negotiate the rent for a furnished apartment in Baridhara?
Rent prices may be negotiable depending on the landlord, lease terms, and the current demand in the area. It’s always worth discussing the price with us to see if there’s any flexibility.
5. Are utilities included in the rent?

It depends on the landlord and the specific apartment. In some cases, utilities such as water, electricity, gas, and internet are included in the rent. In other cases, you may be required to pay for these separately. Please confirm with us when you inquire about specific apartments.
6. How long is the lease agreement for furnished apartments in Baridhara?

Lease agreements for furnished apartments typically range from 6 months to 1 year, but shorter or longer terms can also be arranged depending on the landlord's preferences. Contact us for more information on lease options.
7. Do I need to provide references to rent a furnished apartment?

Some landlords may require references from previous landlords or employers as part of the rental process, while others may not. It’s best to check with us when you are inquiring about specific apartments.
8. Can I bring my own furniture if I rent a furnished apartment?
Most furnished apartments are fully equipped, but if you have specific furniture needs or wish to bring your own items, it's possible to discuss this with the landlord through Sharif Properties.
9. Is parking available for rented furnished apartments in Baridhara?

Many furnished apartments in Baridhara come with parking facilities, either in the form of an assigned parking space or a general parking area. Availability varies from building to building, so please check with us for details.
10. How do I apply for a furnished apartment for rent in Baridhara?

To apply for a furnished apartment, simply get in touch with Sharif Properties. We will guide you through the process, help you find available apartments that suit your needs, and assist with the lease agreement.
11. What documents are required to rent a furnished apartment in Baridhara?

Typically, you will need a valid ID, proof of income, and possibly references from previous landlords or employers. We can provide a full list of required documents when you contact us for apartment rentals.
12. Can I rent a furnished apartment in Baridhara for short-term stays?
Yes, short-term rentals are available in Baridhara, depending on the landlord's preferences. We can help you find suitable short-term rental options for your stay in the area.
13. Are pets allowed in furnished apartments in Baridhara?
Pet policies vary by apartment. Some landlords allow pets, while others do not. Please inquire with Sharif Properties for pet-friendly apartment options.
14. How do I schedule a viewing for a furnished apartment in Baridhara?
You can schedule a viewing by contacting Sharif Properties directly. We will arrange a convenient time for you to visit the apartment and assess whether it meets your requirements.
15. Can I renew my lease after the contract ends?

blocks.text: Property Maintenance Services in Dhaka: Keeping Your Space Safe, Clean, and Functional

Maintaining a property in Dhaka, whether it's a residential home, commercial space, or industrial property, requires consistent attention and expertise. The hustle and bustle of the city, coupled with its unique climate challenges, means that regular property maintenance is essential to ensure safety, comfort, and longevity.
Why Property Maintenance Matters in Dhaka?

Dhaka is known for its rapid urbanization, dense population, and humid climate, all of which can take a toll on buildings and infrastructure. Without regular maintenance, properties can quickly deteriorate, leading to costly repairs, safety risks, and a decline in overall value.
Here’s why property maintenance is crucial:

Preventative Care: Regular maintenance helps catch minor issues before they become major problems. Whether it's a leaky roof, a clogged drain, or electrical issues, early intervention can save you significant time and money.
Improved Property Value: A well-maintained property is more appealing to potential buyers or tenants. Regular upkeep enhances curb appeal, making your property stand out in a competitive market.

Health & Safety: Overlooking regular maintenance can create unsafe living or working environments. Ensuring that plumbing, electrical systems, and structural elements are in good condition can prevent accidents and health hazards.

Weather-Resilience: Dhaka's climate, with its long monsoon seasons and high humidity, can cause rapid wear and tear on buildings. Routine checks for waterproofing, ventilation, and drainage are essential to protect your property from water damage and mold growth.
Comprehensive Property Maintenance Services in Dhaka

At Sharif Properties Service, we provide reliable, efficient, and cost-effective property maintenance services tailored to meet the needs of residential, commercial, and industrial properties in Dhaka. Our expert team ensures that your property stays in prime condition year-round.
Our Services Include:
Plumbing and Drainage Solutions: We fix leaks, unclog drains, repair burst pipes, and ensure your plumbing system works smoothly, helping to prevent water damage and mold growth.

Electrical System Maintenance: Our certified electricians perform safety checks, fix wiring issues, and ensure your electrical systems are up to code, reducing the risk of fire and electrical malfunctions.
Air Conditioning & Ventilation: Regular servicing of air conditioners and ventilation systems ensures that your home or office remains comfortable, reducing energy costs and avoiding breakdowns.
Painting & Aesthetic Touch-Ups: We offer painting and touch-up services to enhance your property’s appearance. Fresh coats of paint can also protect surfaces from the elements.

blocks.text: Sanitary Mistry in Dhaka: Ensuring Hygienic and Efficient Plumbing Solutions

Sanitary mistry, or sanitary workers, play a crucial role in maintaining the plumbing and sanitation systems in Dhaka. With the rapid urbanization of the city, the demand for skilled sanitary technicians has grown significantly. These professionals ensure that homes, offices, and commercial buildings have proper water supply, drainage, and waste management systems.
Importance of Sanitary Mistry in Dhaka
Installation and Maintenance of Plumbing Systems
Sanitary mistry are responsible for installing new plumbing systems in residential and commercial buildings.
They repair and maintain pipes, faucets, water tanks, and sewage lines to prevent leaks and blockages.
Ensuring Proper Waste Management
Effective waste disposal is essential for a clean environment, and sanitary mistry help in setting up proper drainage systems.
They address issues related to clogged drains, sewage backups, and waterlogging, which are common in Dhaka.
Water Supply System Maintenance
Dhaka faces water supply challenges, and sanitary workers ensure the smooth functioning of water lines.
They install and repair water pumps, filters, and pipelines to provide uninterrupted water supply.
Emergency Plumbing Services
Many sanitary mistry offer emergency services to address urgent issues like burst pipes, overflowing drains, or broken water connections.
These quick-response services prevent further damage to properties and improve overall hygiene.
Challenges Faced by Sanitary Mistry in Dhaka
Lack of Proper Training: Many workers acquire skills through apprenticeships rather than formal training programs.
Health and Safety Risks: Exposure to sewage, chemicals, and contaminated water poses health hazards.
Inconsistent Wages: Many sanitary workers face irregular employment opportunities and low wages.
Limited Access to Modern Tools: Traditional methods are still widely used, while advanced plumbing technology is not always available.
Finding a Reliable Sanitary Mistry in Dhaka
If you need sanitary services in Dhaka, consider the following:
Look for experienced and well-reviewed professionals.
Ask for service guarantees and pricing estimates.
Ensure they use quality materials and tools.
Hire through trusted platforms or referrals.
Conclusion

Sanitary mistry in Dhaka play an indispensable role in ensuring clean and efficient plumbing systems. Despite facing challenges, their contributions to hygiene, sanitation, and public health are invaluable. Supporting these workers with proper training and fair wages can improve their efficiency and the overall sanitation system in Dhaka.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Real Estate Broker in Bangladesh
General Questions
1. What services do you offer as a real estate broker?

We provide services including buying, selling, renting, and leasing properties such as apartments, houses, commercial spaces, and land. We also offer legal assistance, property valuation, and market analysis.
2. Do you deal with both residential and commercial properties?
Yes, we deal with a wide range of properties, including residential apartments, commercial office spaces, retail shops, industrial land, and more.
3. How do I start working with a real estate broker?You can contact us via phone, email, or visit our office to discuss your property needs. We will guide you through the process step by step.
Buying & Selling
4. What are the legal requirements for buying property in Bangladesh?
Buyers need to verify the ownership, check land records (khatiyan), obtain a sales deed, and register the property with the local authorities. We assist clients in verifying all legal documents.
5. What fees are involved in purchasing a property?
Fees include registration fees, stamp duty, VAT, legal fees, and broker commission, which varies depending on the property type and location.
6. How long does it take to buy or sell a property?
The timeline varies depending on market conditions, property location, and legal documentation. Typically, it takes a few weeks to a few months.
Renting & Leasing
7. What are the key considerations when renting a property?
Tenants should check the lease agreement, rent terms, advance payment, security deposit, and maintenance policies before signing a contract.
8. How is the rental price determined?
Rental prices are based on factors like location, property condition, amenities, and market demand. We provide comparative market analysis to help determine fair rent.
9. What is the process for leasing commercial property?
For commercial leases, we assist in negotiations, drafting agreements, obtaining necessary permits, and ensuring compliance with business regulations.
Broker Fees & Agreements
10. What are your commission rates?
Our commission rates vary depending on the type of transaction:
Buying/Selling: 1-5% of the transaction value.
Renting/Leasing: One month’s rent as commission.
11. Do you provide written agreements?
Yes, we ensure all transactions are documented with proper agreements to protect both buyers and sellers.
Legal & Documentation
12. How do I verify the authenticity of a property before purchasing?
We help clients verify ownership documents, land records, tax clearance, and encumbrance certificates to ensure a secure transaction.
13. Do you offer legal assistance for property transactions?
Yes, we work with experienced property lawyers who assist in legal documentation, dispute resolution, and contract drafting.
Miscellaneous
14. Can foreigners buy property in Bangladesh?
Foreigners can lease property but cannot directly purchase land. However, they can invest in real estate through joint ventures or companies registered in Bangladesh.
15. What trends are currently shaping the real estate market in Bangladesh?
The market is influenced by urban development projects, increasing demand for affordable housing, and government policies affecting real estate investments.

short-term rental apartment dhaka

Looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Dhaka? Check out our selection of service apartments! Offering all the amenities of a home away from home, our fully furnished apartments are perfect for business travelers or those visiting Dhaka for an extended period. Plus, our excellent location near popular attractions and restaurants makes discovering the city easy and enjoyable. Contact us today to reserve your apartment!

These apartments offer all the conveniences of home, including a kitchen and laundry facilities, but often come furnished and offer more services than a traditional hotel room. Check out these tips for finding the perfect service apartment in Dhaka!
How to Find the Perfect Service Apartment in Dhaka , service apartment gulshan

Dhaka is a bustling city with a lot to offer, from delicious food to historic sights. However, it can be tricky to find somewhere to stay that meets all your needs. If you're looking for a comfortable and convenient place to call home during your stay in Dhaka, a service apartment is a great option.
Here are a few tips on how to find the perfect service apartment in Dhaka

Luxury 2BHK Service Apartment in Banani: Beautiful 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment with a stylish living and dining area, fully furnished, and car parking. Just a short walk to nearby markets, available for TK 150,000 per month.

Premium 4BHK Service Apartment in Dhanmondi: Spacious 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom apartment with large living and dining areas, modern kitchen, and car parking. Located near restaurants and business hubs, available for TK 250,000 per month.

Elegant 3BHK Service Apartment in Uttara: Comfortable 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment with open living spaces, premium interiors, and parking. Close to airports and markets, available for TK 110,000 per month.

Modern 3BHK Service Apartment in Mohammadpur: Cozy 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment with contemporary interiors and a functional kitchen. Includes 1 parking spot, close to schools and hospitals, available for TK 130,000 per month.

Exclusive 5BHK Service Apartment in Baridhara: Luxurious 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom apartment with expansive living spaces, high-end furnishings, and 3 car parking spots. Prime location near diplomatic zones, available for TK 350,000 per month.

Stylish 3BHK Service Apartment in Gulshan : Spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment with modern living and dining areas and parking. Perfectly located near hospitals and markets, available for TK 170,000 per month.

Sophisticated 2BHK Service Apartment in Niketon: Bright 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment with a modern open layout, and parking available. Close to offices and malls, available for TK 70,000 per month.

Luxury 3BHK Service Apartment in Banani: Elegant 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom apartment with a large living and dining area, and car parking. Conveniently located near shopping and office spaces, available for TK 220,000 per month.

Spacious 4BHK Service Apartment in Gulshan-2: Modern 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom apartment with luxury finishes, expansive living areas, and 2 parking spots. Close to corporate offices and shopping, available for TK 275,000 per month.

Consider your budget and what you're willing to pay for comfort and convenience. There is a range of service apartments available at different price points, so it's important to know what you're looking for before you start your search.

Think about what location is most important to you. Do you want to be close to the action, or would you prefer a more peaceful area? Keep in mind that Dhaka is a large city, so it's important to narrow down your search area.

Consider what amenities are most important to you. Do you need a fully equipped kitchen, or would a simple room suffice? Do you need laundry facilities on-site, or are you happy to use a local laundromat? Taking the time to consider your needs will help you find the perfect
service apartment in Dhaka
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1. What is a serviced apartment in Dhaka?

A serviced apartment is a fully furnished apartment available for short-term or long-term rental. It provides the comfort of home with added services like housekeeping, security, and sometimes even utilities such as internet, cable TV, and maintenance, total service inclued in serviced apartment Dhaka.
2. How can I book a serviced apartment in Dhaka?

You can book a serviced apartment directly through our website by selecting your desired apartment type, dates, and filling out the booking form. Alternatively, you can call or email us to make a reservation.
3. What amenities are included in the serviced apartments?
Our serviced apartments in Dhaka include:
Fully furnished rooms
High-speed internet
Cable TV
24/7 security
Daily housekeeping
Kitchen with essential appliances
Laundry facilities (depending on the apartment)
Gym access (in some locations)
Parking spaces
4. What is the minimum stay duration for service Apartment in Dhaka?

The minimum stay duration varies depending on the apartment type and location, but generally, we offer flexible terms with stays starting from a week. Please check the specific apartment details for more information.
5. Can I rent an apartment for a few days only?
Yes, we offer both short-term and long-term rentals. You can rent an apartment for as few as 3 days, depending on availability.
6. Is there a deposit required to book a serviced apartment?

Yes, a security deposit is usually required when booking. The amount depends on the length of stay and the apartment type. This deposit is refundable at the end of your stay, subject to the condition of the apartment.
7. Are utilities included in the rental price?
Yes, the rental price generally includes utilities such as electricity, water, gas, internet, and cable TV. Any additional services like laundry or parking may incur extra charges.
8. Can I extend my stay if needed for service Apartment in Dhaka?
Yes, you can extend your stay based on availability. Please inform us in advance so we can ensure your accommodation is extended.
9. What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in time is typically from 2:00 PM, and check-out time is by 12:00 PM. If you need to check in earlier or check out later, please contact us to request flexibility, and we will do our best to accommodate you.
10. Do you provide transportation services?
Yes, we offer transportation services, including airport transfers, car rentals, and chauffeur services. Please inquire when making your booking for more details.
11. Are pets allowed in the serviced apartments?
Pets are allowed in select apartments, but please check with us beforehand to confirm availability and any associated fees or restrictions.
12. What is the cancellation policy?

Our cancellation policy varies depending on the apartment and rental duration. Typically, we offer a full refund if you cancel within a certain period before your check-in date. Please refer to your booking terms for specific cancellation guidelines.
13. How do I contact you for more information or assistance?

You can contact us through the contact form on our website, email us at [mail@sharif.com.bd], or call us directly at [+8801636-333333 | +8801916-555222]. Our customer service team is available 24/7 to assist you.
